assay: bulk total RNA-seq (Takara Pico-Input), Illumina HiSeq 2000, mouse jugular-nodose ganglia (JNG)
sample_inclusion: 6-week-old C57BL/6J male mice, n=3 PBS (vehicle) and n=3 S961 (insulin receptor antagonist, 10 nmol/week, osmotic pump, 2 weeks); JNG harvested (S2.1.p1, S4.2.2.p1)
primary_estimand: Effect of S961-induced acute insulin resistance (vs PBS vehicle) on JNG gene expression. No exercise, training or physical-activity intervention exists in the sequenced experiment; 'physical activity' in the paper is a CLAMS phenotype readout of AAV-FGF3 mice (S2.2.p1), and exercise is mentioned only in Discussion (S3.p2).
planned_contrasts: S961 vs PBS (S2.1.p1; paper: 90 DEGs, 66 up / 24 down, FDR < 0.05)
paper_method: DESeq2 Wald test (S4.3.2.p1); GEO data_processing instead states edgeR glmQLFTest
paper_results: 90 DEGs (66 up, 24 down) S961 vs PBS; Fgf3 log2(S961/PBS) ~ 3.6 (S2.1.p1, Table S2)
